unsupported_mechanic.ability_reference: FD10/005: "CHAOS Drain" If this card would leave the field, you may destroy a size 3 or less monster on your field. If you do, this card remains on your field.
unsupported_mechanic.what_is_known: Intercepts this card leaving the field, replacing it by destroying another size 3 or less monster on the field to remain on field.
information_needed: Approved schema for WOULD_LEAVE_FIELD replacement rule with monster destruction cost.

unsupported_mechanic.ability_reference: FD10/005: [Overkill:REBØØT] [During an attack on your opponent's turn, drop a hand card] Nullify the attack. Then, if your opponent's cards attacked four times or more during this turn, end the turn!!
unsupported_mechanic.what_is_known: Special Overkill counter timing: drops a hand card during opponent's attack, nullifies attack, and conditionally forces turn end if attack count >= 4.
information_needed: Approved schema for [Overkill:REBØØT] and END_TURN effect.

en.plain:
[Call Cost] [Pay 3 gauge]
At the start of each player's attack phase, call up to one size 3 or less 《Chaos》 from your hand or drop zone without paying its [Call Cost].
"CHAOS Drain" If this card would leave the field, you may destroy a size 3 or less monster on your field. If you do, this card remains on your field.
[Overkill:REBØØT] [During an attack on your opponent's turn, drop a hand card] Nullify the attack. Then, if your opponent's cards attacked four times or more during this turn, end the turn!!
[CHAOS Territory] [Double Attack]
